title: Palak Tambuli
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

    palak

    curd

    grated coconut

    cumin

    green chilli

    salt

    how to prepare:
        In a frying pan add 2 teaspoon ghee and add cumin seeds 1 teaspoon, half teaspoon black pepper,
        3 green chillies and 1 bunch spinach and fry for 2 mins keep it aside. In a mixi jar 
        fried spinach grated coconut and sour curd grind them into smooth paste then adjust the 
        consistency and add salt to taste and serve with hot rice.
